name: Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful fried rice dish made with cooked rice, beaten egg, soya sauce, and mixed vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Bring water to a boil. Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in water. Add rice, salt, and butter. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Drain rice in a strainer for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok or frying pan. Add beaten egg and soya sauce. Cook until just setting.
Add cooked rice and vegetables to the egg mixture. Stir continuously until combined.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and additional soya sauce if needed.

keywords: chicken fried rice, vegetable fried rice, Chinese-Canadian side dish

_similar.name: Sweet and Sour Pineapple with Chicken and Ginger
_similar.description: A classic sweet and sour dish featuring parboiled chicken legs in a tangy pineapple and ginger sauce, served over fried rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Rinse and separate chicken legs at the joint. Parboil for 15 to 20 minutes to remove excess fat.
Saute onions and celery in vegetable oil until tender. Add drained mushrooms and cook briefly.
Dissolve chicken Oxo cube in hot water. Add soya sauce, ginger, salt, sugar, and vinegar. Bring to a boil.
Mix cornstarch with cold water until smooth. Pour into boiling sauce and stir frequently until thickened.
Add drained pineapple to the sauce. Adjust seasoning with pineapple juice if desired.
Lay parboiled chicken pieces in a greased casserole dish. Pour sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling.
Serve over Chicken Vegetable Fried Rice.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, ginger sauce

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Richard's Sunday Soup
_similar.description: A rich and comforting soup featuring carrots, potatoes, and chicken stock.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel and dice the carrots and potato. Combine diced onion and oil in a saucepan and cook over medium heat.
Add the diced carrots and potato to the onion and cook for 3 minutes.
Add chicken stock and sugar. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked.
Remove from heat and puree. Serve immediately with fresh bread.

_similar.keywords: carrot soup, potato soup, chicken stock

_similar.name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.

_similar.keywords: tomato macaroni soup, comfort food, pasta soup
